footnote_text: Represents restricted shares granted to the reporting person pursuant to the Health in Tech Equity Incentive Plan upon his appointment as CEO ("Shares"). Such Shares vest in twelve equal monthly installments, commencing November 1, 2026, subject to continued service through the applicable vesting date.

Represents Shares which shall be automatically forfeited without consideration unless a performance-based acquisition milestone is achieved by December 31, 2028. Such Shares vest in full upon the closing of a qualifying acquisition, subject to continued service through such closing.

Represents Shares which shall be automatically forfeited without consideration unless a certain performance-based milestone (the "Milestone") is achieved by April 30, 2028 (the "Achievement Date"). Such Shares vest in twelve equal monthly installments, subject to continued service. If the Achievement Date falls before the 15th calendar day of the month, vesting commences on such 15th day, and if after, commences on the 1st day of the next calendar month.

Represents Shares which shall be automatically forfeited without consideration unless the Milestone is achieved by the Achievement Date. Such Shares vest in twelve equal monthly installments, subject to continued service. If the Achievement Date falls before the 15th calendar day of the month, vesting commences on such 15th day, and if after, commences on the 1st day of the next calendar month.
